wikipedia.title: Fort Churchill Solar Array
wikipedia.extract: The Fort Churchill Solar Array is a 19.9 megawatt (MWAC) concentrator photovoltaics power station near the city of Yerington in Lyon County, Nevada. It is the largest assembly of SunPower C7 tracker low concentration PV (LCPV) technology in the United States.  The facility was constructed for Apple Inc. to service its Reno Technology Park Data Center.
